# Languages & Communication — Course Outline

**Faculty:** Faculty of Art  
**Path id:** `art-languages-communication`  
**Tier:** foundation · **Annual school fees:** APW$ 450 (dual tender)  
**Audience:** Senior High

## Description

Build precise reading, writing, and speaking skills for academic and civic life.

## Objectives

- Build Senior High competence aligned to the faculty mission.
- Complete each lesson card with a written practice response.
- Be ready to discuss ideas aloud in class mode.

## Lesson sequence

| # | Lesson | File |
|---|--------|------|
| 1 | Rhetoric in Everyday Speech | `lessons/01-rhetoric-everyday.md` |
| 2 | Close Reading for Argument | `lessons/02-close-reading.md` |
| 3 | Academic Paragraph Craft | `lessons/03-academic-paragraphs.md` |
| 4 | Oral Presentation Studio | `lessons/04-oral-presentation.md` |
| 5 | Language Across Cultures | `lessons/05-language-across-cultures.md` |

## Assessment (v1)

Opening a lesson card and engaging the practice prompt counts as progress. Formal exams are out of scope for this content pack version.
